DataTypes.Description: XCGF standard library: core data types, modelled on the HLA OMT (IEEE 1516-2010), plus the XCGF ReferenceData extension.

BasicData.name: HLAfloat64BE
BasicData.Semantics: 64-bit IEEE 754 floating point number, big-endian (HLA standard representation).

SimpleData.name: AngleDegrees
SimpleData.Semantics: Angle in degrees (latitude, longitude, heading, field of view...).

SimpleData.name: Count
SimpleData.Semantics: Number of items (shots, waypoints...), without unit.

Enumerator.name: Off
Enumerator.Semantics: Radar switched off: no emission, no detection.

Enumerator.name: Search
Enumerator.Semantics: Volume search: scans the field of view to detect new contacts.

Enumerator.name: Track
Enumerator.Semantics: Tracking: follows designated contacts accurately enough to guide a weapon.

EnumeratedData.name: FormationEnum
EnumeratedData.Semantics: Geometric arrangement of the members of a unit.

Enumerator.name: Line
Enumerator.Semantics: Line abreast: members side by side.

Enumerator.name: Trail
Enumerator.Semantics: Trail: members one behind the other.

Enumerator.name: Echelon
Enumerator.Semantics: Echelon: members staggered diagonally on one side.

Enumerator.name: Wedge
Enumerator.Semantics: Wedge: V shape with the leader at the front.

Enumerator.name: Spread
Enumerator.Semantics: Spread: wide lateral spacing for mutual support.

ArrayData.name: HLAASCIIstring
ArrayData.Semantics: Variable-length ASCII character string (HLA standard array).

FixedRecordData.name: Orientation
FixedRecordData.Semantics: Attitude of an entity, in degrees.

Field.name: Heading
Field.Semantics: Heading from true north, clockwise, in [0, 360).

Field.name: Roll
Field.Semantics: Roll, positive right wing down, in [-180, 180].

FixedRecordData.name: FlightPlanWaypoint
FixedRecordData.Semantics: Point of a flight plan, with the speed to hold when flying towards it.

Field.name: Speed
Field.Semantics: Speed to hold on the leg ending at this waypoint.

ArrayData.name: FlightPlan
ArrayData.Semantics: Ordered list of waypoints flown one after the other.

ReferenceData.name: EntityReference
ReferenceData.Semantics: Reference to an entity instance. The archetype only declares the data item; the target instance is chosen in the scenario.

ReferenceData.name: EquipmentReference
ReferenceData.Semantics: Reference to an equipment instance, chosen in the scenario.

ReferenceData.name: UnitReference
ReferenceData.Semantics: Reference to a unit instance, chosen in the scenario.
